linux.command: bash -c 'setsid pnpm dev & VitePid=$!; echo $VitePid > .vscode/vite.pid; trap "kill -INT -- -$VitePid 2>/dev/null; wait $VitePid 2>/dev/null; rm -f .vscode/vite.pid; exit 0" INT TERM EXIT; wait $VitePid'

windows.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$Process = Start-Process pnpm -ArgumentList 'dev' -PassThru; $Process.Id | Set-Content '.vscode/vite.pid'; try { Wait-Process -Id $Process.Id } finally { Remove-Item '.vscode/vite.pid' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"

linux.command: bash -c 'if [ -f .vscode/vite.pid ]; then PID=$(cat .vscode/vite.pid); kill -INT -- -$PID 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f .vscode/vite.pid; fi'

windows.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path '.vscode/vite.pid') { $Pid = Get-Content '.vscode/vite.pid'; Stop-Process -Id $Pid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item '.vscode/vite.pid' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
